clauses.quote: A Consulting Teacher who is assigned a Referred Participating Teacher will receive a stipend of $4,000.
clauses.subject_text: A Consulting Teacher who is assigned a Referred Participating Teacher

clauses.quote: Consulting Teachers who are assigned to Volunteer Participating Teachers will receive a stipend of $2,000 per Volunteer Participating Teacher.
clauses.subject_text: Consulting Teachers who are assigned to Volunteer Participating Teachers

clauses.quote: Consulting Teachers who provide services for less than a full year shall have their stipends prorated accordingly.
clauses.subject_text: Consulting Teachers who provide services for less than a full year

clauses.quote: A Consulting Teacher who is approved but not assigned to a Participating Teacher shall be referred for consideration of other teacher support activities determined by the Joint committee as established in the Memorandum of Understanding.
clauses.subject_text: A Consulting Teacher who is approved but not assigned to a Participating Teacher

clauses.quote: Consulting Teachers shall be reimbursed for all reasonable and necessary expenses incurred in the performance of their duties directly related to the PAR Program.

The Consulting Teacher shall meet with the Referred Participating Teacher and the evaluator of the Referred Participating Teacher to receive and discuss the Referred Participating Teacher's previously-established performance objectives as per Article V, section 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 of the SAEA/SAUSD contract.
The Consulting Teacher shall conduct multiple observations of the Participating Teacher during classroom instruction
The Consulting Teacher shall have both pre-observation and post-observation conferences.
The Consulting Teacher shall monitor the progress of the Referred Participating Teacher
The Consulting Teacher shall submit to, and discuss with, the Referred Participating Teacher at least two (2) written Reports.
Consulting Teacher shall prepare a Final Peer Review Report on the Referred Participating Teacher he/she assists.
This Report shall be submitted to the Peer Review Panel, the designated evaluator of the Participating Teacher, and the Participating Teacher.
clauses.notes: Grammatical subject is inanimate; implicit agent is the administering party.

clauses.quote: The Referred Participating Teacher may attach a written response to the Consulting Teacher's Report
The Referred Participating Teacher may request a meeting with the Peer Review Panel to discuss the Report within 20 duty days.
The Referred Participating Teacher has the right to an Association representative of his or her choice
